mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.task_id, a.process_id, a.quantity, a.team_id, a.report_type, b.user_name, c.`name` process_name, d.serial_number, task.ask_complete_time, pl.`name` 'production_line.name', fa.`name` 'factory.name', w.`name` 'workshop.name' FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team_user_link b ON a.team_id = b.team_id AND b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND b.bool_leader_enum = TRUE LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process c ON c.id = a.process_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble d ON a.product_id =d.id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact d ON a.product_id =d.id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure d ON a.product_id =d.id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble d ON a.product_id =d.id
LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team te ON te.id=a.team_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_task task ON task.id=a.task_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_factory fa ON te.factory_id=fa.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_production_line pl ON te.production_line_id=pl.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_workshop w ON te.workshop_id=w.id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND a.product_id = #{productId} AND a.product_type =#{productType} AND a.task_id =#{taskId} AND a.process_id in
#{processId}
ORDER BY process_id, task_id, team_id, report_type

SELECT IFNULL(SUM( a.quantity ) ,0)quantity
,IFNULL( SUM( ta.net_weight ), 0 ) completeNetWeight
,IFNULL( SUM( ta.length ), 0 ) completeLength
FROM mes_enclosure_complete a LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_task mbt ON mbt.production_line_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id= a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure ta ON ta.id= a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON ta.id= a.product_id
and a.project_id=#{projectId}
and a.production_line_id=#{productionLineId}
AND DATE(a.create_time)>=DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(a.create_time)<=DATE(#{endDate})

SELECT IFNULL(SUM( a.complete_quantity ),0) complete_quantity, IFNULL( SUM( a.task_quantity ), 0 ) task_quantity, a.wage_quota_type, a.product_id, a.project_id 'project.id', a.monomer_id 'monomer.id', a.plan_id 'areaDetail.id', a.project_name 'project.name', a.project_short_name 'project.short_name', a.project_contract_no 'project.serial_number', a.monomer_name 'monomer.name', a.areaDetail_name 'areaDetail.name', a.wage, a.leader_name,
a.`name`,
a.serial_number,
a.specification,
a.team_id, a.product_type,
IFNULL(SUM( a.task_net_weight),0) task_net_weight,
IFNULL(SUM( a.task_length),0) task_length, IFNULL(SUM( a.complete_length),0) complete_length,
IFNULL(SUM( a.complete_net_weight),0) complete_net_weight,
IFNULL(SUM( a.mate),0) mate, IFNULL(SUM( a.price),0) price FROM ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM( a.inspection_quantity ),0) complete_quantity, a.task_quantity, a.wage_quota_type, a.product_id, a.project_id , a.monomer_id , a.plan_id , cp.`name` project_name, cp.short_name project_short_name, cp.serial_number project_contract_no, pm.`name` monomer_name, pd.`name` areaDetail_name, a.wage, a.leader_name,
a.`name`,
a.serial_number,
a.specification,
a.team_id, a.product_type,
a.task_net_weight,
a.task_length task_length, IFNULL(SUM( a.complete_length),0) complete_length,
IFNULL(SUM( a.complete_net_weight),0) complete_net_weight,
IFNULL(SUM( a.mate),0) mate, CASE a.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN IFNULL( SUM( a.mate*a.wage), 0 ) WHEN 2 THEN IFNULL( SUM( a.mate*a.wage), 0 ) ELSE IFNULL( SUM( a.mate*a.wage), 0 ) END price FROM ( SELECT a.inspection_quantity, mbp.wage_quota_type, mbt.task_quantity, mbt.product_id, mbt.project_id, mbt.monomer_id, IFNULL(mbes.wage,0)wage, us.`name` leader_name,
ta.`name`,
ta.serial_number,
ta.specification,
a.team_id, mbt.plan_id, mbt.product_type,
mbt.task_quantity*ta.net_weight task_net_weight,
mbt.task_quantity*ta.weight task_net_weight,
mbt.task_quantity*ta.length task_length, ta.length * a.inspection_quantity complete_length,
ta.net_weight * a.inspection_quantity complete_net_weight,
ta.weight * a.inspection_quantity complete_net_weight,
CASE mbp.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN ta.net_weight * a.inspection_quantity/1000 WHEN 2 THEN ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 ELSE ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 END
CASE mbp.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN ta.net_weight * a.inspection_quantity/1000 WHEN 2 THEN ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 ELSE ta.surface_area*a.inspection_quantity/1000/1000 END
CASE mbp.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN ta.weight * a.inspection_quantity/1000 WHEN 2 THEN ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 ELSE ta.length*ta.width*a.inspection_quantity/1000/1000 END
ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000
mate FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_task mbt ON mbt.id = a.task_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_extra_salary mbes ON mbes.team_id = a.team_id AND mbes.product_id = a.product_id AND mbes.product_type = a.product_type AND mbes.bool_used_enum =1 LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team team ON team.id = a.team_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team_user_link tu ON tu.team_id = a.team_id AND tu.bool_leader_enum=TRUE AND tu.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user us ON us.id=tu.user_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process mbp ON mbp.id=team.process_id WHERE team.organization_type = 0 AND mbt.project_id=#{projectId} AND mbt.product_type=#{productType} AND team.process_id=#{processId} ) AS a LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON pd.id = a.plan_id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
AND us.leader_name like CONCAT('%', #{leaderName},'%')
AND pa.`name` like CONCAT('%', #{monomerName},'%')
AND pd.`name` like CONCAT('%', #{areaName},'%')
AND a.serial_number like CONCAT('%', #{serialNumber},'%')
GROUP BY a.wage_quota_type, a.product_id, a.project_id , a.monomer_id , a.plan_id , cp.`name`, cp.short_name , cp.serial_number , pm.`name` , pd.`name`, a.wage, a.leader_name,
a.`name`,
a.specification,
a.serial_number, a.team_id, a.product_type,
a.task_net_weight,
a.task_length, a.task_quantity)as a GROUP BY a.wage_quota_type, a.product_id, a.project_id , a.monomer_id , a.plan_id , a.project_name, a.project_short_name, a.project_contract_no, a.monomer_name, a.areaDetail_name, a.wage, a.leader_name,
a.`name`,
a.specification,
a.serial_number, a.team_id, a.product_type

SELECT a.*, a.project_id 'project.id', a.monomer_id 'monomer.id', a.plan_id 'areaDetail.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`name` 'areaDetail.name' FROM ( SELECT a.wage, a.wage_quota_type, a.user_id, user_table.`name` user_name, process.`name` process_name, a.product_id, product.project_id, product.monomer_id, product.plan_id, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time,'%Y/%m/%d') date,
product.`name`,
product.plate, product.color, product.category,
product.serial_number, product.material,
product.specification,
a.quantity complete_quantity, a.price price, CASE a.wage_quota_type
WHEN 1 THEN product.net_weight*a.quantity WHEN 2 THEN product.length*a.quantity ELSE a.quantity END
WHEN 1 THEN product.net_weight*a.quantity WHEN 2 THEN product.length*a.quantity WHEN 4 THEN product.surface_area*a.quantity ELSE a.quantity END
WHEN 1 THEN product.weight*a.quantity WHEN 2 THEN product.length*a.quantity WHEN 4 THEN product.length*product.width*a.quantity ELSE a.quantity END
WHEN 1 THEN product.net_weight*a.quantity WHEN 2 THEN product.length*a.quantity ELSE a.quantity END mate FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report_price a LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_produce_team_report team ON a.team_reoprt_id = team.id LEFT JOIN sys_user user_table ON team.user_id = user_table.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process process ON a.process_id = process.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_task task ON task.id=a.task_id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON product.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure product ON product.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON product.id = a.product_id
a.product_type & #{productType}
AND a.wage_quota_type=#{wageQuotaType}
AND task.project_id in
#{projectId}
AND a.team_id=#{teamId}
AND task.project_id=#{projectId}
AND task.factory_id=#{factoryId}
AND DATE(a.create_time)>=DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(a.create_time)<=DATE(#{endDate})
) a LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON pd.id = a.plan_id

SELECT report.task_process_id id, report.create_time, report.number, product.serial_number, c.user_name teamLeaderName FROM `mes_enclosure_produce_team_report` report LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON report.product_id = product.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team_user_link c ON report.team_id = c.team_id AND c.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND c.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE task_process_id = #{previousTaskProcessId} AND report.bool_delete_enum = 0

select mr.id, mr.number, mr.process_id, wr.status, b.name from mes_enclosure_produce_team_report mr LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_warehouse_record wr on wr.product_id = mr.product_id and mr.number = wr.number and wr.type = 1 and wr.product_type = #{taskTypeEnum} and plan_id = #{planId} LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process b on b.id = mr.process_id where mr.id in (select max(a.id) from mes_enclosure_produce_team_report a where a.product_id = #{productId} and a.task_id = #{taskId} and a.task_type_enum = #{taskTypeEnum} and a.inspection_quantity = 1 GROUP BY a.number)

SELECT DISTINCT report.process_id 'process.id', process.`name` 'process.name', production_line.id 'productionLine.id', production_line.`name` 'productionLine.name', report.groups_id 'groups.id', gro.`name` 'groups.name', users.id 'user.id', users.`name` 'user.name', sum(report.quantity) quantity, process.sort
,report.create_time date
FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_task_process task_process ON report.task_process_id = task_process.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = task_process.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process process ON process.id = report.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_groups gro ON gro.id=report.groups_id LEFT JOIN sys_user users ON users.id = report.user_id WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND report.product_id = #{productId} AND report.task_type_enum = 2
AND report.number=#{number}
GROUP BY report.process_id, production_line.id, report.groups_id, users.id
,report.create_time

select.if:
SELECT `month`, SUM(mete) mete FROM ( SELECT `month`, task_id, MIN(mete) mete FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time,"%Y-%m") MONTH, report.task_id, report.quantity * artifact.net_weight mete FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON report.product_id = artifact.id WHERE task_type_enum = 2
AND artifact.project_id= #{projectId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time, "%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, "%Y")
AND process_id IN ( SELECT id FROM mes_enclosure_process WHERE product_type = 2 AND type = #{processTypeEnum})) a GROUP BY `month`, task_id ) a GROUP BY `month`

mapper.select:
SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.shortName', cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', pm.id 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pa.id 'area.id', pa.`name` 'area.name', a.id, a.serial_number, a.specification, a.material, a.length, a.net_weight, a.inspection_quantity quantity FROM ( SELECT
CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.project_id END project_id, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.monomer_id END monomer_id, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.plan_id ELSE null END plan_id, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.id END id, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.serial_number END serial_number, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.specification END specification, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.length END length, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.material END material, CASE report.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN ta.net_weight END net_weight,
ta.project_id, ta.monomer_id, ta.plan_id, ta.id, ta.serial_number, ta.material, ta.specification, ta.length, ta.net_weight,
SUM( report.inspection_quantity ) inspection_quantity FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_groups gro ON gro.id = report.groups_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = report.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON ta.id = report.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part ta ON report.product_id =ta.id
WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND gro.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND report.task_type_enum &16
AND report.task_type_enum = #{taskTypeEnum}
AND report.team_id = #{teamId}
AND report.groups_id = #{groupsId}
AND report.process_id = #{processId}
AND DATE(report.create_time)>=DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(report.create_time)<=DATE(#{endDate})
GROUP BY report.task_type_enum, ta.project_id, ta.monomer_id, ta.plan_id, ta.id ) a LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = a.plan_id

SELECT DISTINCT report.process_id 'process.id', process.`name` 'process.name', production_line.id 'productionLine.id', production_line.`name` 'productionLine.name', report.groups_id 'groups.id', gro.`name` 'groups.name', users.id 'user.id', users.`name` 'user.name', sum(report.quantity) quantity, process.sort FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_task_process task_process ON report.task_process_id = task_process.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = task_process.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process process ON process.id = report.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_groups gro ON gro.id=report.groups_id LEFT JOIN sys_user users ON users.id = report.user_id WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND report.product_id = #{productId} AND report.task_type_enum = 16 GROUP BY report.process_id, production_line.id, report.groups_id, users.id

SELECT enc.category 'category', IFNULL(SUM( rep.quantity * enc.length ) ,0) 'completeLength' FROM mes_enclosure_produce_team_report rep LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure enc ON rep.product_id = enc.id LEFT JOIN contract_project pro ON enc.project_id = pro.id WHERE rep.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND date(rep.create_time) >= date(#{startTime})
AND date(rep.create_time) <= date(#{endTime})
AND enc.project_id =#{projectId}
GROUP BY enc.category

select report.*, en.id 'enclosureId', en.name 'enclosureName', en.bool_status_enum 'boolStatusEnum' from mes_enclosure_produce_team_report report left join tech_enclosure en on report.product_id = en.id where report.bool_delete_enum = 0 and report.task_order_id = #{orderId} and report.task_id in
#{taskId}

select en.id, en.name from mes_enclosure_task task left join tech_enclosure en on task.product_id = en.id and task.category = en.category where task.bool_delete_enum = 0 and task.task_order_id = #{orderId} and en.bool_status_enum = false and task.id in
#{taskId}
